verdict.rationale: Snyk is delivered as a SaaS platform (with a local CLI and MCP server that call into the cloud service); no evidence in the pack indicates a self-hostable version of the core Snyk platform/backend. Missing for 10: any documentation of an on-prem/self-hosted deployment option for the core scanning platform, license/packaging for self-hosting, or infrastructure requirements to run Snyk's backend independently of Snyk's cloud.
